scope: Historical author-procedure replay for protein; the corrected production variance intentionally differs. All signed test flags checked against author outputs; four-decimal effect classification reproduces printed counts. This is not a claim that the public estimator yields the paper counts.
preprocessing: Keep all sequences and W_ParE3 fitness without rescaling; restrict neighbors to one-nucleotide-accessible amino-acid replacements. Replay author duplicated-target variance, n=min(k_u,k_v), df=n-1, two-sided tests, separate all-pair BH families at FDR .01; classify effects after four-decimal formatting.
